summary: Frontend-only verification of ParentPinModal keypad rewrite (hidden TextInput → tap-based numeric keypad). Login as papa@demo.fr worked. PIN keypad renders in tasks-admin, rewards-admin and challenges (via delete-challenge trigger). Correct PIN 1234 unlocks and opens the corresponding form. Wrong PIN (9999) surfaces 'PIN incorrect' via testID parent-pin-error and clears dots. Backspace (pin-key-del) removes digits correctly. Cancel button (parent-pin-cancel-button) closes modal without side effects. PIN token persists in the same session — subsequent parent action (delete task) executed without re-prompt. Task and reward creation via keypad flow were saved and appeared in the list. Note: The 'open-add-challenge' end-to-end create flow could not be tested against the demo family because there is always an active weekly challenge in the seed data, so the '+' button is not rendered (button is gated by !challenge in challenges.tsx). The keypad itself was still exercised on the challenges screen via the delete-challenge PIN trigger and works. A pre-existing bug unrelated to this fix was observed on challenges.tsx (see rca_of_issue).

integration_issues.flow: challenges.tsx delete-challenge (parent) when no pin token
integration_issues.issue: remove() triggers setPinRequired(true) but ParentPinModal onSuccess unconditionally does setOpenAdd(true), so entering the correct PIN opens the 'create challenge' form instead of re-executing the delete. Pre-existing bug, NOT caused by the keypad rewrite. Reference: /app/frontend/app/shared/challenges.tsx:53-58 and :176.

action_items: (Optional) Fix challenges.tsx remove() so ParentPinModal onSuccess re-runs the pending action (delete vs. create). Currently onSuccess always opens the create modal. Pre-existing, unrelated to the keypad fix.
(Optional) To make the challenge create flow easier to E2E test with the demo family, consider seeding the demo without an active challenge, or provide a way to reset it.
critical_code_review_comments: ParentPinModal.tsx is clean, correctly uses Pressable + testIDs (pin-key-0..9, pin-key-del, parent-pin-modal, parent-pin-error, parent-pin-cancel-button), and auto-submits at 4 digits.
verifyPin() and storage-based token flow are unchanged; the fix is scoped exactly as described (only the input mechanism changed).

success_rate.frontend: 100% for PIN keypad scenarios in scope

seed_data_creation: Created and cleaned up: TEST_TacheKeypad (task) and TEST_RecompenseKeypad (reward). Deleted the seeded 'Semaine au top' challenge during testing (this was seeded; will re-seed on backend restart if applicable).
context_for_next_testing_agent: PIN keypad flow is confirmed working across tasks-admin, rewards-admin, and challenges (delete trigger). Testing was performed at mobile viewport 390x844 against EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL. The demo challenge is always seeded, blocking end-to-end verification of the create-challenge form via open-add-challenge unless the challenge is first removed.
rca_of_issue: The reported keypad-vs-hidden-TextInput bug is properly fixed: ParentPinModal now uses on-screen Pressable digits (pin-key-1..9, pin-key-0, pin-key-del) and auto-submits at 4 digits via verifyPin(). Verified: (1) tasks flow: open-add-task → pin-modal → 1234 → task-title-input visible → save-task-button creates task; (2) rewards flow: open-add-reward → pin-modal → 1234 → reward-title-input visible → save-reward-button creates reward; (3) wrong PIN 9999 → parent-pin-error shows 'PIN incorrect' and dots cleared; (4) pin-key-del correctly removes last digit; (5) parent-pin-cancel-button closes modal with no side effect; (6) after a successful PIN unlock, deleting a task did not re-prompt (token persisted). Separate pre-existing bug: challenges.tsx remove() opens the create-challenge form after PIN success because ParentPinModal.onSuccess unconditionally does setOpenAdd(true) instead of re-running the pending action. Suggested mitigation: track a pending action (create|delete) in state and dispatch it in onSuccess.
